## Description (1918/4000)
Tournaments for Magic players.

Run your store's Friday night or your kitchen-table draft, play your matches and keep your collection, in one account on iPhone, Android and the web.

RUN YOUR OWN EVENTS
Swiss pairings, the round clock, results and standings for a Friday night, a kitchen-table draft or a team event, by the Magic Tournament Rules. Players join with a QR code or a link; standings update for everyone.

PLAY YOUR MATCHES
Scan the organizer's QR code and you're seated. Keep life and counters, report the result when the match ends, and your opponent confirms. Your record keeps every match.

YOUR RECORD, EVERY EVENT
Your lifetime record, head-to-head against the people you play most, and every event's standings and results, from the first draft on. Share your record with friends, or keep it to yourself.

INSIGHTS FOR YOUR DECKS
The matchup grid puts your decks first and marks the archetypes your collection can nearly build, from tournament results on Magic Online, TopDeck.gg and Melee. Each deck shows its archetype's win rate this week, what it beats and what beats it.

BRING YOUR COLLECTION
Import an export from ManaBox, Moxfield, Archidekt, Deckbox, Dragon Shield, TCGplayer or Delver Lens and see what matched before anything is written. Decks and cubes from links or paste. Export whenever you like, or scan cards with your phone.

RANK CUBES AND SETS
Order each colour of a cube or a new set, settle the top 100, compare rankings with friends and refine yours with first picks. New sets are rankable in spoiler season, with 17Lands data once the set is on Arena.

Table 1 is free, with no ads or purchases, and the same account works on iPhone, Android and the web at table-1.site.
